Dormant statuses for Men's Ultimate Frisbee, NAACP and Natives at Penn come only from old dated items on their own club pages while the directory lists them as accepting members; these need a human check. Personal-looking student emails in the directory (Ice Hockey, MMA, MLSA) were not recorded. Directory application flags are numeric and unexplained, so only written text was used for newcomer ratings. Several tags are nearest fits (lacrosse, ultimate, music business, pre-med, Models@Penn); each is explained in the record's notes. The fetch tool summarizes pages, so exact wording is the summary's and was kept to the fields listed.
